# Spring Implementation Skill

Use this skill when implementing new features.

## Steps

1. Identify similar implementation.
2. Locate controller.
3. Locate facade.
4. Locate service.
5. Reuse repository patterns.
6. Generate code.
7. Generate tests.
8. Validate logging.
9. Validate error handling.

## Repository Rules

- Java 21
- Spring Boot 3
- Constructor injection
- Thin controllers
- Business logic in services
- Existing stereotypes

## Deliverables

- changed files
- implementation
- tests
- validation steps
